summary: Horizon Space Acquisition I Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC (HSPO), filed an 8-K on Oct 13, 2026 disclosing a business combination agreement dated Oct 12, 2026 with ArcheNova Technology entities and operating target ArcheNova Biotech Corp. The structure uses a PubCo, ArcheNova Technology, with Merger Sub I merging into HSPO and Merger Sub II into ArcheNova Biotech, leaving both as wholly-owned PubCo subsidiaries. HSPO units detach into shares, warrants and rights; each Right converts into one-tenth of an ordinary share. PubCo shares are expected to list on Nasdaq. Watch redemptions, trust value, PIPE funding, and closing conditions.
